name: Time Stream Slasher and Blister Chain on-hit procs fire (#10732)
contract: Time Stream Slasher's proc dummies (202053, worldforged 312573/316573/320573) say "Your melee attacks and direct damaging spells have a chance to ... cause an additional Arcane damage" with ProcChance 7, and Blister Chain's (304158, worldforged 313273/317273/321273) say "your attacks have a chance to blister the target" with ProcChance 25. All eight carry DBC ProcFlags 0 and had no spell_proc row, so Aura::GetProcEffectMask found no entry and neither ever procced; the reporter saw no proc in 500+ auto attacks. Expected: each dummy loads its record's chance; a landed melee auto attack procs both at about their chance, a direct magic damage spell procs Time Stream Slasher only, and a ranged auto attack procs Blister Chain only.
